library WebAuthn {

    /*.•°:°.´+˚.*°.˚:*.´•*.+°.•°:´*.´•*.•°.•°:°.´:•˚°.*°.˚:*.´+°.•*/

    /// @notice Defines a struct for WebAuthn authentication data.
    ///
    /// @dev This struct is used to store WebAuthn authentication details, including:
    /// - `authenticatorData`: The WebAuthn authenticator data as per the WebAuthn specification.
    /// - `clientDataJSON`: The WebAuthn client data JSON as per the WebAuthn specification.
    /// - `challengeIndex`: The start index of the "challenge":"..." substring within `clientDataJSON`.
    /// - `typeIndex`: The start index of the "type":"..." substring within `clientDataJSON`.
    /// - `r`: The r value of the secp256r1 signature.
    /// - `s`: The s value of the secp256r1 signature.
    ///
    /// This struct is typically used in WebAuthn-based authentication mechanisms.
    struct WebAuthnAuth {
        bytes authenticatorData;
        string clientDataJSON;
        uint256 challengeIndex;
        uint256 typeIndex;
        bytes32 r;
        bytes32 s;
    }

    /*´:°•.°+.*•´.*:˚.°*.˚•´.°:°•.°•.*•´.*:˚.°*.˚•´.°:°•.°+.*•´.*:*/

    /*.•°:°.´+˚.*°.˚:*.´•*.+°.•°:´*.´•*.•°.•°:°.´:•˚°.*°.˚:*.´+°.•*/

    /// @notice Verifies a WebAuthn authentication challenge using the provided parameters.
    ///
    /// @param challenge The challenge bytes to be verified.
    /// @param requireUserVerification A boolean indicating whether user verification is required.
    /// @param auth A WebAuthnAuth struct containing authentication data.
    /// @param x The x-coordinate of the public key.
    /// @param y The y-coordinate of the public key.
    /// @return result A boolean indicating whether the verification was successful.
    function verify(
        bytes memory challenge,
        bool requireUserVerification,
        WebAuthnAuth memory auth,
        bytes32 x,
        bytes32 y
    ) internal view returns (bool result) {
        result = verify(
            challenge,
            requireUserVerification,
            auth.authenticatorData,
            auth.clientDataJSON,
            auth.challengeIndex,
            auth.typeIndex,
            auth.r,
            auth.s,
            x,
            y

    }

    /// @notice Verifies a WebAuthn authentication challenge using the provided parameters.
    ///
    /// @param challenge The challenge bytes to be verified.
    /// @param requireUserVerification A boolean indicating whether user verification is required.
    /// @param authenticatorData The WebAuthn authenticator data as per the WebAuthn specification.
    /// @param clientDataJSON The WebAuthn client data JSON as per the WebAuthn specification.
    /// @param challengeIndex The start index of the "challenge":"..." substring within `clientDataJSON`.
    /// @param typeIndex The start index of the "type":"..." substring within `clientDataJSON`.
    /// @param r The r value of the secp256r1 signature.
    /// @param s The s value of the secp256r1 signature.
    /// @param x The x-coordinate of the public key.
    /// @param y The y-coordinate of the public key.
    /// @return result A boolean indicating whether the verification was successful.
    function verify(
        bytes memory challenge,
        bool requireUserVerification,
        bytes memory authenticatorData,
        string memory clientDataJSON,
        uint256 challengeIndex,
        uint256 typeIndex,
        bytes32 r,
        bytes32 s,
        bytes32 x,
        bytes32 y

        string memory encodedChallenge = Base64.encode(challenge, true, true);

        // Verify the signature by computing the hash over authenticatorData and clientDataJSON.
        result = _verify(
            encodedChallenge,
            requireUserVerification,
            authenticatorData,
            clientDataJSON,
            challengeIndex,
            typeIndex,
            r,
            s,
            x,
            y

    /*´:°•.°+.*•´.*:˚.°*.˚•´.°:°•.°•.*•´.*:˚.°*.˚•´.°:°•.°+.*•´.*:*/
    /*                 ENCODE / DECODE OPERATIONS                  */
    /*.•°:°.´+˚.*°.˚:*.´•*.+°.•°:´*.´•*.•°.•°:°.´:•˚°.*°.˚:*.´+°.•*/

    /// @notice Encodes a WebAuthnAuth struct into a bytes array.
    ///

    /// @return encoded The encoded bytes representation of the WebAuthnAuth struct.
    function encodeAuth(WebAuthnAuth memory auth) internal pure returns (bytes memory encoded) {

    /// @notice Attempts to decode WebAuthn authentication data from the provided encoded bytes.
    ///

    function tryDecodeAuth(bytes memory encodedAuth) internal pure returns (WebAuthnAuth memory decoded) {
        /// @solidity memory-safe-assembly
        assembly {
            let o := add(encodedAuth, 0x20)
            let e := add(o, mload(encodedAuth))

            let p := mload(o)

            // Validate authenticatorData pointer.
            if iszero(lt(add(o, p), e)) { break }
            let adLen := mload(add(o, p))
            if iszero(lt(add(add(o, p), adLen), e)) { break }

            // Validate clientDataJSON pointer.
            let cdp := mload(add(o, add(p, 0x20)))
            if iszero(lt(add(o, cdp), e)) { break }
            let cdLen := mload(add(o, cdp))
            if iszero(lt(add(add(o, cdp), cdLen), e)) { break }

            // Store authenticatorData.
            mstore(decoded, mload(add(o, p)))
            mstore(add(decoded, 0x20), mload(add(add(o, p), 0x20)))
            let adSrc := add(add(o, p), 0x20)
            let adDst := add(decoded, 0x40)
            for { let i := 0 } lt(i, adLen) { i := add(i, 0x20) } {
                mstore(add(adDst, i), mload(add(adSrc, i)))
            }

            // Store clientDataJSON.
            mstore(add(decoded, 0x40), mload(add(o, cdp)))
            let cdSrc := add(add(o, cdp), 0x20)
            let cdDst := add(add(decoded, 0x40), 0x20)
            for { let i := 0 } lt(i, cdLen) { i := add(i, 0x20) } {

299:     function _verify(
300:         string memory encodedChallenge,
301:         bool requireUserVerification,
302:         bytes memory authenticatorData,
303:         string memory clientDataJSON,
304:         uint256 challengeIndex,
305:         uint256 typeIndex,
306:         bytes32 r,
307:         bytes32 s,
308:         bytes32 x,
309:         bytes32 y
310:     ) private view returns (bool) {
311:         // The clientDataJSON should be:
312:         // '{"type":"webauthn.get","challenge":"...","origin":"...","crossOrigin":...}'
313:         //
314:         // We need to check:
315:         // 1. The "type" field is "webauthn.get".
316:         // 2. The "challenge" field matches the base64url-encoded challenge.
317:         // 3. The User Present flag (bit 0) is set in authenticatorData.
318:         // 4. If user verification is required, the User Verified flag (bit 2) is set.
319:         // 5. The Attested Credential Data flag (bit 6) is NOT set.
320:         // 6. The signature over SHA256(authenticatorData || clientDataJSON) is valid.
321: 
322:         bytes32 hash;
323:         /// @solidity memory-safe-assembly
324:         assembly {
325:             let m := mload(0x40)
326:             let clientDataJSONLen := mload(clientDataJSON)
327: 
328:             // Check if `clientDataJSON` has the correct "type":"webauthn.get".
329:             // The `typeIndex` points to the start of the value of "type" (after the colon).
330:             // We expect `"webauthn.get"` starting at `typeIndex + 1` (skipping the opening quote).
331:             let typePtr := add(add(clientDataJSON, typeIndex), 0x20)
332:             // The value at `typePtr` should start with `"webauthn.get"`.
333:             // We check the first 13 characters: "webauthn.get"
334:             // `"webauthn.get"` is 0x22776562617574686e2e67657422
335:             if iszero(eq(mload(typePtr), "webauthn.get")) {
336:                 mstore(0x00, 0) // `false`.
337:                 return
338:             }
339: 
340:             // Check if the `challenge` matches.
341:             // The `challengeIndex` points to the start of the value of "challenge" (after the colon).
342:             // We skip the opening quote character.
343:             let challengePtr := add(add(clientDataJSON, challengeIndex), 0x21)
344:             let encodedChallengeLen := mload(encodedChallenge)
345:             for { let i := 0 } 1 { i := add(i, 0x20) } {
346:                 if iszero(lt(i, encodedChallengeLen)) {
347:                     // Check that the next character is a closing quote.
348:                     if iszero(eq(byte(0, mload(add(challengePtr, i))), 0x22)) {
349:                         mstore(0x00, 0) // `false`.
350:                         return
351:                     }
352:                     break
353:                 }
354:                 if iszero(eq(mload(add(challengePtr, i)), mload(add(encodedChallenge, add(i, 0x20))))) {
355:                     mstore(0x00, 0) // `false`.
356:                     return
357:                 }
358:             }
359: 
360:             // Check if `authenticatorData` has the correct flags.
361:             // The first 32 bytes of `authenticatorData` (after the length) contain rpIdHash (32 bytes).
362:             // The flags byte is at byte offset 32.
363:             let flags := byte(0, mload(add(add(authenticatorData, 32), 32)))
364:             // User Present flag (bit 0) must be set.
365:             if iszero(and(flags, 0x01)) {
366:                 mstore(0x00, 0) // `false`.
367:                 return
368:             }
369:             // User Verified flag (bit 2) must be set if user verification is required.
370:             if and(requireUserVerification, iszero(and(flags, 0x04))) {
371:                 mstore(0x00, 0) // `false`.
372:                 return
373:             }
374:             // Attested Credential Data flag (bit 6) must NOT be set.
375:             if and(flags, 0x80) {
376:                 mstore(0x00, 0) // `false`.
377:                 return
378:             }
379: 
380:             // Compute `hash = sha256(authenticatorData || clientDataJSON)`.
381:             // Copy `authenticatorData` to `m`.
382:             let adLen := mload(authenticatorData)
383:             mstore(m, adLen)
384:             mcopy(add(m, 0x20), add(authenticatorData, 0x20), adLen)
385:             // Copy `clientDataJSON` to `m + adLen`.
386:             mcopy(add(add(m, 0x20), adLen), add(clientDataJSON, 0x20), clientDataJSONLen)
387:             hash := sha256(add(m, 0x20), add(adLen, clientDataJSONLen))
388:         }

        // 2. The "challenge" field matches the base64url-encoded challenge.

        // 4. If user verification is required, the User Verified flag (bit 2) is set.
        // 5. The Attested Credential Data flag (bit 6) is NOT set.
        // 6. The signature over SHA256(authenticatorData || clientDataJSON) is valid.

        bytes32 hash;
        /// @solidity memory-safe-assembly
        assembly {
            let m := mload(0x40)
            let clientDataJSONLen := mload(clientDataJSON)

            // The `typeIndex` points to the start of the value of "type" (after the colon).
            // We expect `"webauthn.get"` starting at `typeIndex` (skipping the opening quote).
            let typePtr := add(add(clientDataJSON, typeIndex), 0x21)

            for { let i := 0 } lt(i, 13) { i := add(i, 0x20) } {

                    mstore(0x00, 0) // `false`.
                    return(0x00, 0x20)
                }
            }

            // Check if the `challenge` matches.
            // The `challengeIndex` points to the start of the value of "challenge" (after the colon).
            // We skip the opening quote character.
            let challengePtr := add(add(clientDataJSON, challengeIndex), 0x21)
            let encodedChallengeLen := mload(encodedChallenge)
            for { let i := 0 } 1 { i := add(i, 0x20) } {
                if iszero(lt(i, encodedChallengeLen)) {
                    // Check that the next character is a closing quote.
                    if iszero(eq(byte(0, mload(add(challengePtr, i))), 0x22)) {
                        mstore(0x00, 0) // `false`.
                        return(0x00, 0x20)
                    }
                    break

                if iszero(eq(mload(add(challengePtr, i)), mload(add(encodedChallenge, add(i, 0x20))))) {
                    mstore(0x00, 0) // `false`.
                    return(0x00, 0x20)
                }

            // The first 32 bytes of `authenticatorData` (after the length) contain rpIdHash (32 bytes).
            // The flags byte is at byte offset 32.
            let flags := byte(0, mload(add(add(authenticatorData, 32), 32)))
            // User Present flag (bit 0) must be set.

326:     /// @dev The internal verification function.
327:     function _verify(
328:         string memory encodedChallenge,
329:         bool requireUserVerification,
330:         bytes memory authenticatorData,
331:         string memory clientDataJSON,
332:         uint256 challengeIndex,
333:         uint256 typeIndex,
334:         bytes32 r,
335:         bytes32 s,
336:         bytes32 x,
337:         bytes32 y
338:     ) private view returns (bool) {
339:         // The clientDataJSON should be:
340:         // '{"type":"webauthn.get","challenge":"...","origin":"...","crossOrigin":...}'
341:         //
342:         // We need to check:
343:         // 1. The "type" field is "webauthn.get".
344:         // 2. The "challenge" field matches the base64url-encoded challenge.
345:         // 3. The User Present flag (bit 0) is set in authenticatorData.
346:         // 4. If user verification is required, the User Verified flag (bit 2) is set.
347:         // 5. The Attested Credential Data flag (bit 6) is NOT set.
348:         // 6. The signature over SHA256(authenticatorData || clientDataJSON) is valid.
349: 
350:         bytes32 hash;
351:         /// @solidity memory-safe-assembly
352:         assembly {
353:             let m := mload(0x40)
354:             let clientDataJSONLen := mload(clientDataJSON)
355: 
356:             // Check if `clientDataJSON` has the correct "type":"webauthn.get".
357:             // The `typeIndex` points to the start of the value of "type" (after the colon).
358:             // We expect `"webauthn.get"` starting at `typeIndex` (skipping the opening quote).
359:             let typePtr := add(add(clientDataJSON, typeIndex), 0x21)
360:             // Verify 13 characters: "webauthn.get".
361:             for { let i := 0 } lt(i, 13) { i := add(i, 0x20) } {
362:                 if iszero(eq(mload(add(typePtr, i)), mload(add("webauthn.get", i)))) {
363:                     mstore(0x00, 0) // `false`.
364:                     return(0x00, 0x20)
365:                 }
366:             }
367: 
368:             // Check if the `challenge` matches.
369:             // The `challengeIndex` points to the start of the value of "challenge" (after the colon).
370:             // We skip the opening quote character.
371:             let challengePtr := add(add(clientDataJSON, challengeIndex), 0x21)
372:             let encodedChallengeLen := mload(encodedChallenge)
373:             for { let i := 0 } 1 { i := add(i, 0x20) } {
374:                 if iszero(lt(i, encodedChallengeLen)) {
375:                     // Check that the next character is a closing quote.
376:                     if iszero(eq(byte(0, mload(add(challengePtr, i))), 0x22)) {
377:                         mstore(0x00, 0) // `false`.
378:                         return(0x00, 0x20)
379:                     }
380:                     break
381:                 }
382:                 if iszero(eq(mload(add(challengePtr, i)), mload(add(encodedChallenge, add(i, 0x20))))) {
383:                     mstore(0x00, 0) // `false`.
384:                     return(0x00, 0x20)
385:                 }
386:             }
387: 
388:             // Check if `authenticatorData` has the correct flags.
389:             // The first 32 bytes of `authenticatorData` (after the length) contain rpIdHash (32 bytes).
390:             // The flags byte is at byte offset 32.
391:             let flags := byte(0, mload(add(add(authenticatorData, 32), 32)))
392:             // User Present flag (bit 0) must be set.
393:             if iszero(and(flags, 0x01)) {
394:                 mstore(0x00, 0) // `false`.
395:                 return(0x00, 0x20)
396:             }
397:             // User Verified flag (bit 2) must be set if user verification is required.
398:             if and(requireUserVerification, iszero(and(flags, 0x04))) {
399:                 mstore(0x00, 0) // `false`.
400:                 return(0x00, 0x20)
401:             }
402:             // Attested Credential Data flag (bit 6) must NOT be set.
403:             if and(flags, 0x80) {
404:                 mstore(0x00, 0) // `false`.
405:                 return(0x00, 0x20)
406:             }
407: 
408:             // Compute `hash = sha256(authenticatorData || clientDataJSON)`.
409:             // Copy `authenticatorData` to `m`.
410:             let adLen := mload(authenticatorData)
411:             for { let i := 0 } lt(i, adLen) { i := add(i, 0x20) } {
412:                 mstore(add(add(m, 0x20), i), mload(add(add(authenticatorData, 0x20), i)))
413:             }
414:             // Copy `clientDataJSON` to `m + adLen`.
415:             for { let i := 0 } lt(i, clientDataJSONLen) { i := add(i, 0x20) } {
416:                 mstore(add(add(add(m, 0x20), adLen), i), mload(add(add(clientDataJSON, 0x20), i)))
417:             }
418:             mstore(0x00, 0)
419:             pop(staticcall(gas(), 2, add(m, 0x20), add(adLen, clientDataJSONLen), 0x00, 0x20))
420:             hash := mload(0x00)
421:         }
422:         return P256.verifySignature(hash, r, s, x, y);
423:     }

333:         uint256 typeIndex,
334:         bytes32 r,
335:         bytes32 s,

340:         // '{"type":"webauthn.get","challenge":"...","origin":"...","crossOrigin":...}'
341:         //
342:         // We need to check:
343:         // 1. The "type" field is "webauthn.get".
344:         // 2. The "challenge" field matches the base64url-encoded challenge.
345:         // 3. The User Present flag (bit 0) is set in authenticatorData.
346:         // 4. If user verification is required, the User Verified flag (bit 2) is set.
347:         // 5. The Attested Credential Data flag (bit 6) is NOT set.
348:         // 6. The signature over SHA256(authenticatorData || clientDataJSON) is valid.
349: 
350:         bytes32 hash;
351:         /// @solidity memory-safe-assembly
352:         assembly {
353:             let m := mload(0x40)
354:             let clientDataJSONLen := mload(clientDataJSON)
355: 
356:             // Check if `clientDataJSON` has the correct "type":"webauthn.get".
357:             // The `typeIndex` points to the start of the value of "type" (after the colon).
358:             // We expect `"webauthn.get"` starting at `typeIndex` (skipping the opening quote).
359:             let typePtr := add(add(clientDataJSON, typeIndex), 0x21)
360:             // Verify 13 characters: "webauthn.get".
361:             for { let i := 0 } lt(i, 13) { i := add(i, 0x20) } {
362:                 if iszero(eq(mload(add(typePtr, i)), mload(add("webauthn.get", i)))) {
363:                     mstore(0x00, 0) // `false`.
364:                     return(0x00, 0x20)
365:                 }
366:             }
367: 
368:             // Check if the `challenge` matches.
369:             // The `challengeIndex` points to the start of the value of "challenge" (after the colon).
370:             // We skip the opening quote character.
371:             let challengePtr := add(add(clientDataJSON, challengeIndex), 0x21)
372:             let encodedChallengeLen := mload(encodedChallenge)
373:             for { let i := 0 } 1 { i := add(i, 0x20) } {

375:                     // Check that the next character is a closing quote.
376:                     if iszero(eq(byte(0, mload(add(challengePtr, i))), 0x22)) {
377:                         mstore(0x00, 0) // `false`.
378:                         return(0x00, 0x20)
379:                     }
380:                     break
381:                 }
382:                 if iszero(eq(mload(add(challengePtr, i)), mload(add(encodedChallenge, add(i, 0x20))))) {
383:                     mstore(0x00, 0) // `false`.
384:                     return(0x00, 0x20)

389:             // The first 32 bytes of `authenticatorData` (after the length) contain rpIdHash (32 bytes).

403:             if and(flags, 0x80) {

406:             }

299:     function _verify(
300:         string memory encodedChallenge,
301:         bool requireUserVerification,
302:         bytes memory authenticatorData,
303:         string memory clientDataJSON,
304:         uint256 challengeIndex,
305:         uint256 typeIndex,
306:         bytes32 r,
307:         bytes32 s,
308:         bytes32 x,
309:         bytes32 y
310:     ) private view returns (bool) {
311:         // The clientDataJSON should be:
312:         // '{"type":"webauthn.get","challenge":"...","origin":"...","crossOrigin":...}'
313:         //
314:         // We need to check:
315:         // 1. The "type" field is "webauthn.get".
316:         // 2. The "challenge" field matches the base64url-encoded challenge.
317:         // 3. The User Present flag (bit 0) is set in authenticatorData.
318:         // 4. If user verification is required, the User Verified flag (bit 2) is set.
319:         // 5. The Attested Credential Data flag (bit 6) is NOT set.
320:         // 6. The signature over SHA256(authenticatorData || clientDataJSON) is valid.
321: 
322:         bytes32 hash;
323:         /// @solidity memory-safe-assembly
324:         assembly {
325:             let m := mload(0x40)
326:             let clientDataJSONLen := mload(clientDataJSON)
327: 
328:             // Check if `clientDataJSON` has the correct "type":"webauthn.get".
329:             // The `typeIndex` points to the start of the value of "type" (after the colon).
330:             // We expect `"webauthn.get"` starting at `typeIndex + 1` (skipping the opening quote).
331:             let typePtr := add(add(clientDataJSON, typeIndex), 0x20)
332:             // The value at `typePtr` should start with `"webauthn.get"`.
333:             // We check the first 13 characters: "webauthn.get"
334:             // `"webauthn.get"` is 0x22776562617574686e2e67657422
335:             if iszero(eq(mload(typePtr), "webauthn.get")) {
336:                 mstore(0x00, 0) // `false`.
337:                 return
338:             }
339: 
340:             // Check if the `challenge` matches.
341:             // The `challengeIndex` points to the start of the value of "challenge" (after the colon).
342:             // We skip the opening quote character.
343:             let challengePtr := add(add(clientDataJSON, challengeIndex), 0x21)
344:             let encodedChallengeLen := mload(encodedChallenge)
345:             for { let i := 0 } 1 { i := add(i, 0x20) } {
346:                 if iszero(lt(i, encodedChallengeLen)) {
347:                     // Check that the next character is a closing quote.
348:                     if iszero(eq(byte(0, mload(add(challengePtr, i))), 0x22)) {
349:                         mstore(0x00, 0) // `false`.
350:                         return
351:                     }
352:                     break
353:                 }
354:                 if iszero(eq(mload(add(challengePtr, i)), mload(add(encodedChallenge, add(i, 0x20))))) {
355:                     mstore(0x00, 0) // `false`.
356:                     return
357:                 }
358:             }

360:             // Check if `authenticatorData` has the correct flags.
361:             // The first 32 bytes of `authenticatorData` (after the length) contain rpIdHash (32 bytes).
362:             // The flags byte is at byte offset 32.
363:             let flags := byte(0, mload(add(add(authenticatorData, 32), 32)))
364:             // User Present flag (bit 0) must be set.
365:             if iszero(and(flags, 0x01)) {
366:                 mstore(0x00, 0) // `false`.
367:                 return
368:             }
369:             // User Verified flag (bit 2) must be set if user verification is required.
370:             if and(requireUserVerification, iszero(and(flags, 0x04))) {
371:                 mstore(0x00, 0) // `false`.
372:                 return
373:             }
374:             // Attested Credential Data flag (bit 6) must NOT be set.
375:             if and(flags, 0x80) {
376:                 mstore(0x00, 0) // `false`.
377:                 return
378:             }
379: 
380:             // Compute `hash = sha256(authenticatorData || clientDataJSON)`.
381:             // Copy `authenticatorData` to `m`.
382:             let adLen := mload(authenticatorData)
383:             mstore(m, adLen)
384:             mcopy(add(m, 0x20), add(authenticatorData, 0x20), adLen)

386:             mcopy(add(add(m, 0x20), adLen), add(clientDataJSON, 0x20), clientDataJSONLen)
387:             hash := sha256(add(m, 0x20), add(adLen, clientDataJSONLen))

- `uint256` (challengeIndex, typeIndex) are encoded directly

326:     /// @dev The internal verification function.
327:     function _verify(
328:         string memory encodedChallenge,
329:         bool requireUserVerification,
330:         bytes memory authenticatorData,
331:         string memory clientDataJSON,
332:         uint256 challengeIndex,
333:         uint256 typeIndex,
334:         bytes32 r,
335:         bytes32 s,
336:         bytes32 x,
337:         bytes32 y
338:     ) private view returns (bool) {
339:         // The clientDataJSON should be:
340:         // '{"type":"webauthn.get","challenge":"...","origin":"...","crossOrigin":...}'
341:         //
342:         // We need to check:
343:         // 1. The "type" field is "webauthn.get".
344:         // 2. The "challenge" field matches the base64url-encoded challenge.
345:         // 3. The User Present flag (bit 0) is set in authenticatorData.
346:         // 4. If user verification is required, the User Verified flag (bit 2) is set.
347:         // 5. The Attested Credential Data flag (bit 6) is NOT set.
348:         // 6. The signature over SHA256(authenticatorData || clientDataJSON) is valid.
349: 
350:         bytes32 hash;
351:         /// @solidity memory-safe-assembly
352:         assembly {
353:             let m := mload(0x40)
354:             let clientDataJSONLen := mload(clientDataJSON)
355: 
356:             // Check if `clientDataJSON` has the correct "type":"webauthn.get".
357:             // The `typeIndex` points to the start of the value of "type" (after the colon).
358:             // We expect `"webauthn.get"` starting at `typeIndex` (skipping the opening quote).
359:             let typePtr := add(add(clientDataJSON, typeIndex), 0x21)
360:             // Verify 13 characters: "webauthn.get".
361:             for { let i := 0 } lt(i, 13) { i := add(i, 0x20) } {
362:                 if iszero(eq(mload(add(typePtr, i)), mload(add("webauthn.get", i)))) {
363:                     mstore(0x00, 0) // `false`.
364:                     return(0x00, 0x20)
365:                 }
366:             }
367: 
368:             // Check if the `challenge` matches.
369:             // The `challengeIndex` points to the start of the value of "challenge" (after the colon).
370:             // We skip the opening quote character.
371:             let challengePtr := add(add(clientDataJSON, challengeIndex), 0x21)
372:             let encodedChallengeLen := mload(encodedChallenge)
373:             for { let i := 0 } 1 { i := add(i, 0x20) } {
374:                 if iszero(lt(i, encodedChallengeLen)) {
375:                     // Check that the next character is a closing quote.
376:                     if iszero(eq(byte(0, mload(add(challengePtr, i))), 0x22)) {
377:                         mstore(0x00, 0) // `false`.
378:                         return(0x00, 0x20)
379:                     }
380:                     break
381:                 }
382:                 if iszero(eq(mload(add(challengePtr, i)), mload(add(encodedChallenge, add(i, 0x20))))) {
383:                     mstore(0x00, 0) // `false`.
384:                     return(0x00, 0x20)
385:                 }
386:             }
387: 
388:             // Check if `authenticatorData` has the correct flags.
389:             // The first 32 bytes of `authenticatorData` (after the length) contain rpIdHash (32 bytes).
390:             // The flags byte is at byte offset 32.
391:             let flags := byte(0, mload(add(add(authenticatorData, 32), 32)))
392:             // User Present flag (bit 0) must be set.
393:             if iszero(and(flags, 0x01)) {
394:                 mstore(0x00, 0) // `false`.
395:                 return(0x00, 0x20)
396:             }
397:             // User Verified flag (bit 2) must be set if user verification is required.
398:             if and(requireUserVerification, iszero(and(flags, 0x04))) {
399:                 mstore(0x00, 0) // `false`.
400:                 return(0x00, 0x20)
401:             }
402:             // Attested Credential Data flag (bit 6) must NOT be set.
403:             if and(flags, 0x80) {
404:                 mstore(0x00, 0) // `false`.
405:                 return(0x00, 0x20)
406:             }
407: 
408:             // Compute `hash = sha256(authenticatorData || clientDataJSON)`.
409:             // Copy `authenticatorData` to `m`.
410:             let adLen := mload(authenticatorData)
411:             for { let i := 0 } lt(i, adLen) { i := add(i, 0x20) } {
412:                 mstore(add(add(m, 0x20), i), mload(add(add(authenticatorData, 0x20), i)))
413:             }
414:             // Copy `clientDataJSON` to `m + adLen`.
415:             for { let i := 0 } lt(i, clientDataJSONLen) { i := add(i, 0x20) } {
416:                 mstore(add(add(add(m, 0x20), adLen), i), mload(add(add(clientDataJSON, 0x20), i)))
417:             }
418:             mstore(0x00, 0)
419:             pop(staticcall(gas(), 2, add(m, 0x20), add(adLen, clientDataJSONLen), 0x00, 0x20))
420:             hash := mload(0x00)
421:         }
422:         return P256.verifySignature(hash, r, s, x, y);

Let me analyze my `tryDecodeAuth` implementation. The issue is likely in how I'm decoding the struct from `abi.encode` output.

For `abi.encode(struct)`:
- The struct fields are encoded as ABI-encoded types
- `bytes` (authenticatorData) is encoded as: offset, length, data
- `string` (clientDataJSON) is encoded as: offset, length, data
- `uint256` (challengeIndex, typeIndex) are encoded directly
- `bytes32` (r, s) are encoded directly

So the ABI encoding of the struct is:
```
offset to authenticatorData
offset to clientDataJSON
challengeIndex
typeIndex
r
s
authenticatorData length
authenticatorData data...
clientDataJSON length
clientDataJSON data...
```

Wait, actually ABI encoding uses absolute offsets from the start of the encoded data.

Let me trace through the decoding logic in `tryDecodeAuth`:
```
o = add(encodedAuth, 0x20)  // start of encoded data
e = add(o, mload(encodedAuth))  // end of encoded data

p = mload(o)  // offset to authenticatorData
```

For a struct encoded with `abi.encode`:
- Position 0: offset to authenticatorData (bytes)
- Position 1: offset to clientDataJSON (string)
- Position 2: challengeIndex
- Position 3: typeIndex
- Position 4: r
- Position 5: s

So `p = mload(o)` reads the first 32 bytes, which is the offset to authenticatorData. This offset is relative to the start of the encoding (i.e., `o`).

Then:
```
adLen = mload(add(o, p))  // length of authenticatorData at the offset
```

This reads the length at `o + p`, which should be the length of the authenticatorData bytes.

Then:
```
